tri॰ nirgato'rTo yasya prA॰ ba॰ vA kap । 1 nizPale “prasAdo nizPalo yasya kroDaScApi nirarTakaH” BA॰ u॰ 35 a॰ । “itTaM jagma nirarTakaM kzititale'ruRye yaTA mAlatI” sA॰ da॰ । 2 aBiDeyaSUnye 3 kAvyadozaBede ca “nirarTakaM tuhItyAdi pUraREkaprayojanam” candrA॰ gOtamokte 4 nigrahasTAnaBede “varRakramanirdeSavannirarTakam” sU॰ “yaTA nityaH SabdaH kacawatapayjavagaqadaStvAt JaBaYGaQaDazabaditi evamprakAraM nirarTakam aBiDAnABiDeyaBAvAnupapattO arTagateraBAvAd varRA eva krameRa nirdiSyanta iti” BA॰ । “varRAnAM krameRa nirdeSo javagaqetyAdiprayogastattulyo nirdeSornirarTakaM nigrahasTAnam avAcakapadaprayoga iti PalitArTaH । avAcakatvaM ca SaktyA nirUQalakzaRayA SAstrapariBAzayA vA boDyaM samayabanDavyatirekeReti biSezaRIyaM tena yatrApaBraMSena vicAraH kartavya iti samayabanDastatrApaBraMSe na dozaH । Jawiti saMvareRa tu na doza ityuktaprAyam । asya samBavaH pramAdAdityavaDeyam” vfttiH । kramaScehAkzarasamAmnAye mAheSvare sUtre yaTA paWitAstaTetyarTaH ।

Ā. -अस्यति, ˚ते, (inf. असितुम्, MBh.; aor. -आस्थत्, Bhaṭṭ.). to cast out, throw or drive away, expel, remove, banish from (abl.), ŚBr.; ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to ward off, keep away, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to strip off (also Ā.), Pāṇ. i, 3, 29, Vārtt. 3, Pat.; to stretch out (हस्तौ, also Ā.), Vop.; to reject, refuse, decline (as a suitor, an offer, &c.), Sāh.; to destroy, annihilate, Yājñ.; MBh.; Hit.
a: निरस् — {c4c} P. 1 To cast out, throw or drive away, give up, quit, drive or send back; निरस्तगांभीयर्मपात्तपुष्पकं Śi. 1. 55, 9. 63. --2 To destroy, ward off, defeat, annihilate; dispel; अह्नाय तावदरुणेन तमो निरस्तं R. 5. 70; रक्षांसे वेदीं परितो निरास्थत् Bk. 1. 12, 2. 36. --3 To turn out, remove, expel, banish; गृहान्निरस्ता न तेन वैदेहसुता मनस्तः R. 14. 84. --4 To throw out, discharge (as arrows). --5 To reject, repudiate, decline. --6 To refute, confute, controvert (as arguments). --7 To eclipse, obscure, throw into the back-ground; Bk. 1. 3. --8 To tear out, strip off. --9 To stretch out (as a hand).

a: निरतिः — f. Strong attachment, fondness, devotion.

v: niratiSaya

pu॰ nirgato'tiSayo yasmAt nitarAmatiSayo vA । 1 atyantAtiSaye 2 svApekzayAtiSayaSUnye 3 parameSvare yadapekzayA kasyApyatiSayABAvaH 4 tasmin tri॰ । “tatra niratiSayaM sArvajYyavIjam” pAta॰ sU॰ “yadidamatItAnAmatapratyutpannapratyekasamuccayAtIndriyagrahaRamalpaM bahviti sArvajYyavIjametadvivardDamAnaM yatra niratiSayaM sa sarvajYaH । asti kAzWAprAptiH sArvajYyavIjasya sAtiSayatvAt parimARavaditi yatra kAzwAprAptirjYAnasya sa sarvajYaH sa ca puruzaviSezaH” BA॰ “vyAcazwe yadidamiti । budDisatvAvarakatamo'pagamatAratamyena yadidamatItAnAgatapratyutpannAnAM pratyekaYca samuccayena ca varttamAnAnAmatIndriyARAM grahaRaM tasya viSezaRamalpaM bahviti sArvajYyavIjaM kAraRam । kaScit kiYcidevAtItAdi gfhRAti kaScid bahutaraM kaScidbahutamam etadvivardDamAnaM yatra nizkrAntamatiSayAt sa sarvajYa iti tadanena prameyamAtraM kaTitam । atra praBARayAta asti kAzWA prAptiH sArvajYyavIjasyeti sADyanirdeSaH niratiSayakAzWA yataH paramatiSayavattA nAstIti । tena nAvaDimAtreRa sidDasADanaM, sAtiSayatvAditi hetuH । yat sAtiSayaM tat tatsarvaM niratiSayaM yaTA kuvalAmalakavilvezu sAtiSayamiti । vyAptiM darSayati parimARavat । na ca garimAdiguRErvyaBicAra iti sAmpratam, na svalva'vayavagarimAvayavinaH kintvA, paramARuBya antyAvayaviByo yAvantaH kecana tezA pratyekaM varttinaM garimARaM samAhftya garimavardDamAnatABimAnaH jYAnantu pratijYeyaM samApyate ityekadvibahuvizayatayA yuktaM sAtiSayamiti na vyaBicAraH” vivaraRam ।
m: निर्—अतिशय mfn. unsurpassed (-त्व n.), Hariv.; Pañc. &c.
निर्—अतिशय—त्व n.

v: niratyaya
tri॰ nirgato'tyayo yasya prA॰ ba॰ । 1 atyayaSUnye “niratyayaM sAma na dAna varjitam” kirA॰ । aBAve'vyayI॰ । 2 atyayABAve avya॰ ।
m: निर्—अत्यय mf(आ)n. free from danger, secure, infallible (-त्व n.), Kāv. &c.
unblamable, faultless, Kir.
causing no pain, Suśr.
निर्—अत्यय—त्व n.

s: niravaH

puM, (ni + ru + “fdorap .” 3 । 3 । 57 । iti BAve ap .) nIravaH । ravABAvaH । iti nipUrvvaruDAtorali nizpannaH । apAlanaYca ॥ (nirgatarakzakaH । yaTA, fksaMhitAyAm । 1 । 122 । 11 । “naBo juvo yanniravasya rADaH .” “niravasya nirgatarakzakasya .” iti tadBAzye sAyaNaH ॥)
m: निर्—अव mfn. unprotected, RV. i, 122, 11; Sāy. (only gen. -अवस्य, perhaps one who calls, fr. √ रु? or ind.p. fr. √ सो?).
निर्-अव-√ धे P. -धयति, to suck out, ĀpŚr.
निर्—अवधि mfn. unlimited, Bhavabh.; Rājat.
endless, infinite, Sarvad. (also ˚धिक).

v: niravaSeza
tri॰ nirgato'vaSezo yasya । avaSezaSUnye samagre “yAvat niravaSezaM Bavati tAvat dAhayitvA” ASva॰ SrO॰ 3 । 11 । 5 ।
m: निर्—अवशेष mfn. without a residue, complete, whole, R. &c.
निर्—अवशेष—तस् ind. completely, totally, fully, Hariv.
निर्—अवशेषेण ind. completely, totally, fully, Hariv.
निर्-˚अवदान n. (Jaim.; ĀpŚr.) allotment or distribution of shares.
निर्-अव-√ दय् Ā. -दयते, to satisfy any one (acc.) with (acc. or instr.) or with respect to (abl.), TS.; Br.
निर्-अव-√ दो P. -दाति, or -द्यति (ind.p. -दाय), to distribute or divide completely, give any one his share, appease or satisfy with (double acc.), TS.
निर्—अवदोष-त्व n. (?), Kauś., Sch.

v: niravadya

tri॰ nirgataBavadyaM dozaH ajYAnaM rAgadvezAdi vA yasya । 1 nirdoze utkfzwe “tasya niravadyavidyoddyotena dyotitastattvato'yamarTaH” dAyaBA॰ । 2 ajYAnaSnye 3 rAgAdiSUnye paramAtmani ca “nizkalaM nizkriyaM SAntaM niravadyaM niraYjanam” SvetA॰ u॰ ।
m: निर्—अवद्य mf(आ)n. unblamable, unobjectionable, Up.; MBh. &c. (-त्व n., BhP.)
निर्—अवद्य n. blamelessness, excellence (-वत् mfn., MBh.)
निर्—अवद्य n. or m. a partic. high number, Lalit.
निर्-अवद्य -अवयव &c. See निर्, p. 539, col. 3.
निर्—अवद्य—त्व n., BhP.
निर्—अवद्य—वत् mfn., MBh.

s: niravagrahaH

puM, (nirgato'vagrahaH pratibanDo yasmAt .) svatantraH । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 15 । (yaTA, harivaMSe । 80 । 9 । “durddamaH kAmacArI ca sa keSI niravagrahaH ॥”) vfzWipratibanDABAvaSca ॥ (mahAdevaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 17 । 82 । “nIlastaTANgalubDaSca SoBano niravagrahaH ॥”)
v: niravagraha

tri॰ nirgatI'vagrahaH pratibanDo vfzwipratibanDo niyamanaM vA yasya prA॰ va॰ । 1 svacCande svatantre anyecCAnaDInapravfttiyukte amaraH । “kecit kroDasamAvizwA madAnDA niravagrahAH” BA॰ BI॰ 94 a॰ । 2 vfzwipratibanDaSUnye ca ।
m: निर्—अवग्रह mfn. unrestrained, independent, free, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (˚हे ind. where there is room to move freely, MBh.)
self-willed, headstrong, W.

k.v: स्याद्दयालुः कारुणिकः कृपालुः सूरतस्समाः। स्वतन्त्रोऽपावृतः स्वैरी स्वच्छन्दो निरवग्रहः॥

m: निर्—अवग्रहे ind., where there is room to move freely, MBh.

s: niravahAlikA
strI, (nir + ava + hala + Rvul । wApi ata itvam .) prAcIram । iti SabdamAlA ॥
m: निर्—अवहालिका f. a fence, hedge, outer wall, L.

v: niravahAnikA
strI nira + ava + hana--Rvul । prAcIre SabdamAlA ।
a: निरवहानि(लि)का — A fence, an outer wall.

m: निरवह m. (fr. निस् + अव + √ हन् ?) a kind of sword, Gal.
निर्—अवका˚शी-√ कृ to remove from its place, Ragh. ix, 28 (C.) Sch.

v: niravakASa
tri॰ nirgato'vakASo yasya prA॰ ba॰ । 1 asamBavatkAlAntarakarttavyatAke kAryye 2 avakASaSUnye ca ।
m: निर्—अवकाश mf(आ)n. wanting room, crowded (said of a hell), BhP.
out of place or time, unseasonable, inconvenient, Hcar.
निर्—अवकाश—ता f., Kād.
निर्—अवलम्ब mfn. supportless (lit. and fig.), Śak.
निर्—अवलम्˚बन mf(आ)n. id., ib. (v.l.)
belonging to nobody, Hcar.
निर्—अवलम्˚बन n. want of a prop or of reliance, MW.
निर्—अवरोध mfn. unrestrained, unopposed, BhP.
निर्—अवसाद mf(आ)n. not cast down, cheerful, Gīt.
anxious, eager, W.

v: niravasita
tri॰ nir + ava + so--kta । yena Bukte pAtraM saMskAreRApi na SuDyati tasmin pAtrabahizkfte caRqAlAdO ।
m: निर्˚अवसित mfn. expelled, rejected, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 10.
निर्—अवस्कृत mfn. (prob.) clean, pure, MBh. (cf. अन्-अवस्कर). =
निर्-अव-√ सो Caus. -साययति, to establish, settle, furnish with (instr.), TS.; TBr.
निर्—अवस्तार mfn. not strewn or covered, bare, BhP.
निर्-अवत्त ˚त्ति. See निर्-अव-दो.
निर्-˚अवत्त mfn. distributed, completely divided or allotted
निर्-˚अवत्त—बलि mfn. whereof oblations have been distributed all round, ŚBr.
निर्-˚अवत्ति f. (TBr.; Kāṭh.) allotment or distribution of shares.
निर्-अव-√ यज् Ā. -यजते, to satisfy a god (acc.) by means of sacrifice in preference to another god (abl.), Kāṭh.

v: niravayava
tri॰ nirgato'vayavo yasya । nyAyamata 1 avayavaSUnye paramARvAkASAdO sarvaTAvayavaSUnye 2 brahmaRi ca “nASakAraRABAvena niravayavadravyARAM nASABAvaH” sA॰ pra॰ BA॰
m: निर्—अवयव mfn. having no limbs or members
not consisting of parts, indivisible (-त्व n.), Śaṃk.; Sarvad. &c.
निर्—अवयव—त्व n.
निर्-अवेक्ष् (√ ईक्ष्) to observe, perceive.
निर्-˚अवेक्ष्य ind. having observed or perceived, Mṛcch. v, 30.

v: niravinda
pu॰ parvatarUpe tIrTaBede “aSmapfzWe gayAyAYca niravinde ca parvate” BA॰ Anu॰ 25 a॰ ।
m: निरविन्द m. (for निर्-अरव्˚ ?) N. of a mountain, MBh.
निर्—अव्यय mf(आ)n. undecaying, eternal, W.
निरयावलि-सूत्र n. N. of wk.

s: nirayaH
puM, (nikfzwaH ayo gamanaM yatra .) narakaH । ityamaraH । 1 । 8 । 1 ॥ (yaTA, harivaMSe । 16 । 16 । “kaTaYca SaktAste dAtuM nirayasTAH PalaM punaH ॥”)
v: niraya
pu॰ nirgato'yotra prA॰ ba॰ nIcEretyatra nir + i AGAre ac vA । narake amaraH “niraye cEva patanaM yAtanASca yamakzaye” manuH ।
m: निर्-अय m. (either fr. निस् + √ इ = egression, sc. from earthly life, or fr. निर् + अय ‘without happiness’) Niraya or Hell (personified as a child of fear and death, BhP.), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.

k.v: स्यान्नारकस्तु नरको निरयो दुर्गतिः स्त्रियाम्. तद्भेदास्तपनावीचिमहारौरवरौरवाः॥

v: nirayaRa
na॰ nir + aya--BAve lyuw । nirgamane । karaRe lyuw । nirgamanopAye “paScAt nirayaRaM kftam” f॰ 10 । 123 । 6 “nirayaRaM nirgamanopAyaH” BA॰ ।
m: निर्-अयण n. (√ इ) egression, RV.
निर्-अय—पति m. the king of hell, BhP.
निर्-अयिन् m. an inhabitant of hell, BhP.

v: nirazwa

pu॰ nirgatAni azwO vayovyaYjanAni yasmAt qadsamA॰ । caturviMSativarzIye 2 aSve “aSvaSataM nirazwaM niramaRam” Sata॰ brA॰ 12 । 4 । 2 । 5 “aSvasya dantagatAni vayovyaYjanAni Bavanti tezAmemEkaM trIRi trIRi barzARi anuvarttate tAnyazwO vyaYjanAni nirgatAnyasmAditi nirazwaM catuviMSativazIyam” BA॰ । nira + akza--kta । 2 nirAkfte tri॰ “vfzAyuDo na vaDrayo nirazwAH” f॰ 1 । 33 । 6 “nirazwA nirAkftAH” BA॰ ।
m: निर्-अष्ट (√ अक्ष्), emasculated, deprived of vigour, RV.; ŚBr. (cf. महा-न्˚).
